blocks.text: Elevate your kitchen organization and storage with this premium Rubbermaid Brilliance Food Storage Container set. The airtight containers are crafted from BPA-free Triton plastic known for its crystal-clear, glass-like appearance that offers 360-degree clarity. These lightweight, stain and odor-resistant containers keep your food fresh and make container identification very simple. In addition, the stackable design allows perfect saving of space. They can withstand the rigors of your freezer, microwave, and dishwasher. They are leak-proof, thus providing a mess-free transport solution, even for soups and sauces.
